shortDescription: SAO PAULO, Sept 8 (Reuters) – Inflation in Brazil as measured by the IGP-DI price index (BRIGPD=ECI) rose 0.06 percent in August, compared to a 0.86 percent drop in July, private think tank Getulio Vargas Foundation said on Tuesday.(By Sao Paulo Newsroom; tel: +5511 56447500)
